name: Resistance
overview: Scripture reveals resistance as a spiritual battle where believers are called to submit to God and actively resist the devil, who is cunning and seeks to deceive (Genesis 3:1; James 4:7). Jesus instructs His followers to shake off rejection and fear God rather than men, emphasizing the eternal significance of the soul over the body (Matthew 10:14, 10:28). God's sovereign authority over all creation, unconfined by human structures, assures believers of His power and presence amid opposition (Acts 17:24; Job 38:1).
